articles.title: Oil eases as markets assess potential waiver on Russian energy, Middle East supply risks
articles.desc: Oil prices fell on Tuesday as markets weighed an executive order from US President Donald Trump that waived some sanctions and tariffs tied to Russian energy exports, while attacks on Saudi Arabia and Yemen kept fears of Middle East supply disruptions in view.

articles.title: HFCL Q2 net profit jumps 448% to Rs 394 crore
articles.desc: Net profit surged 448.14% year-on-year to ₹394.22 crore from ₹71.92 crore a year ago, while revenue increased 143.62% to ₹2,541.79 crore from ₹1,043.34 crore. Sequentially, profit increased 60.49% from the previous month, and revenue rose 32.73%.

articles.title: Steelmakers may outperform non-ferrous peers in Q2 as higher volumes support earnings
articles.desc: Non-ferrous companies are expected to see a sequential decline in earnings, with revenue and Ebitda expected to fall 2% and 13%, respectively. The decline in average LME aluminium prices is likely to weigh on their profitability.

articles.title: UltraTech Cement Q2 net profit up 21% in September quarter
articles.desc: A near 14% year-on-year growth in grey cement volumes to 35.94 mt in the domestic market, though, helped UltraTech clock in a near 19% year-on-year growth in consolidated sales to ₹23,295 crore. This also helped the profit before interest, depreciation and tax rise more than 17% to ₹3,832 crore. Consolidated profit for the quarter rose 21% on-year to ₹1,501 crore.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia cancels 2026 ‘Davos in the Desert’ amid Houthi attacks
articles.desc: Riyadh postpones flagship investment conference until 2027, orders government staff to work from home.

articles.title: ED freezes trading accounts in scam tied to social media
articles.desc: Last week, the ED's Mumbai Zone conducted searches at 29 premises across six cities-Mumbai, Nashik, Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat and Bhavnagar-under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA). The case relates to R M Drip and Sprinklers Systems and R&B Denims, the agency said. According to the ED, the two companies issued more than 35 million shares and convertible warrants through preferential allotments between April 2023 and March 2024. A substantial portion of the funds allegedly came from a small network of connected individuals, firms and lenders, it said.

articles.title: Maharajah Bonds gain investor appeal with TDS exemption
articles.desc: In a notification dated October 19, the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) said no tax would be deducted at source on interest paid to eligible bondholders during financial year 2026-27 and subsequent tax years. The exemption covers residents and foreign institutional investors.

articles.title: NSE, BSE to hold Diwali Muhurat trading on November 8
articles.desc: According to circulars issued by the NSE, the special trading session will begin at 2:20 pm on Sunday. Continuous trading in stocks covered by the closing auction session (CAS) will end at 3:15 pm, followed by the closing auction, while trading in other stocks will continue until 3:30 pm. Equity futures and options trading will run from 2:20 pm to 3:40 pm.

articles.title: India-NZ FTA in force: Over half of New Zealand’s exports to India now tariff-free, Wellington also eyes Brazil, Canada
articles.desc: New Zealand is working to strengthen trade relations with Brazil and Canada in response to economic uncertainties. The country expects to complete the first New Zealand-Brazil Trade and Investment Dialogue after upcoming elections. A new free trade agreement with India has been implemented, making more than half of exports tariff-free. The agreement will benefit various products, including sheep meat and wool, as well as local businesses.

articles.title: Union Bank Q2 net profit up 30% as margins improve
articles.desc: Total advances in the September quarter increased 19% year-on-year to ₹11.6 lakh crore, led by a 17% growth in domestic advances, which was supported by a 24% increase in corporate advances to ₹5.2 lakh crore. The bank has a corporate loan pipeline of ₹1 lakh crore.

articles.title: Brokerages back ICICI Bank on strong Q2 earnings, see HDFC Bank recovery ahead
articles.desc: Brokerages remain optimistic about ICICI Bank's strong earnings and asset quality after the recent quarter. However, HDFC Bank's profit growth was modest, and margins are under pressure, leading to a more cautious outlook. Despite this, both banks have attractive valuations and positive earnings recovery prospects. On Monday, both stocks experienced declines, along with broader market indices. Analysts highlight potential upsides for both banks based on target prices.

articles.title: Jio Platforms' IPO draws Rs 2.5 lakh crore in anchor bids
articles.desc: Global investors included BlackRock Global Funds, Capital Group, Fidelity, New World Fund and American Funds Developing World Growth and Income Fund. Other overseas participants included Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA), Janus Henderson, Societe Generale, Morgan Stanley Investment Funds, Norway's Government Pension Fund Global, Citadel Securities Singapore, Eastspring Investments, T. Rowe Price, Prudential Hong Kong and Integrated Core Strategies (Asia).

articles.title: Banking stocks, high oil prices drag Indian markets lower
articles.desc: Across Asia, markets were mixed, with South Korea rebounding 1.8% from last week's losses amid simmering concerns over excessive investments in artificial intelligence (AI). Taiwan fell 0.6%, while Indonesia tumbled 3.6% following a warning from index provider MSCI that it would downgrade the country from the emerging market basket.

articles.title: Apple India in sweet spot as FY26 revenue crosses Rs 1 lakh crore, profit soars
articles.desc: Apple India's revenue reached ₹1 lakh crore in FY26, reflecting a strong growth trend in smartphone sales. Revenue growth was noted at 31%, exceeding that of its competitor Samsung, which faced a decline. Net profit increased by 66% from the previous fiscal year, highlighting Apple's robust performance. The premium smartphone market saw significant growth, benefiting Apple due to its strong brand appeal.

Its bonds slipped into distressed territory by a common definition - when investors demand 1,000 basis points more in yield than they'd get from government bonds. Last Tuesady Chamath "SPAC King" Palihapitiya noticed the distressed debt, and also asked whether the AI buildout was a private credit bubble. […]

articles.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq leads Wall Street gains as chip, AI stocks rebound
articles.desc: US stocks ended mixed on Monday, with the Nasdaq leading gains as chip and AI-linked stocks bounced back after last week’s sharp selloff. Investors also tracked corporate earnings and fresh stock-specific moves, while concerns over AI spending and financing remained in focus.

articles.title: Ukraine says it carried out first drone airlift of wounded soldier from front line
articles.desc: The serviceman was surrounded by landmines and enemy drones so a ground rescue was not possible, Ukraine's military says.

articles.title: RBI injects Rs 1 lakh crore as liquidity tightens before festive season
articles.desc: On Monday, the RBI announced a Rs 1-lakh-crore variable rate repo (VRR) auction for the first time since late July after the weighted average call rate (WACR) at 5.67% on Monday, or 17 basis points higher than the repo rate of 5.50%. The central bank will conduct another VRR for Rs 50,000 crore on Wednesday.

articles.title: Yes Bank's evaluating capital actions to back growth plans
articles.desc: "The manner and the timing of reinstatement of the bonds as well as payment of the coupon is also under assessment," Niranjan Banodkar, CFO, Yes Bank told analysts over a call after the earnings.

articles.title: China curbs spur push for local manufacturing
articles.desc: India's government will consult stakeholders on measures to mitigate the impact of Chinese export constraints. China recently imposed new restrictions on heavy machinery, such as tunnel boring machines, set to take effect soon. Indian officials assert that there should be no significant slowdown in highway development despite these curbs. The domestic construction industry is becoming increasingly self-sufficient regarding general equipment needs.

articles.title: Finance Ministry to run financial inclusion campaign
articles.desc: The finance ministry is launching a campaign to saturate financial schemes across various local bodies. This initiative will reach 2.70 lakh gram panchayats and urban local bodies throughout India. Banks are expected to organize camps for enrolments and Aadhaar seeding for key schemes. The campaign will also involve updating nominations in savings accounts and providing other financial facilities.

articles.title: RBI tightens scrutiny of $1 billion-plus overseas investments amid rupee pressure
articles.desc: The Reserve Bank of India is implementing stricter scrutiny on large overseas direct investments by Indian companies. Banks must now collect and present detailed information regarding these investments to the RBI. This initiative aims to prevent potential losses for both the companies and the Indian economy. The RBI's checklist requires banks to conduct thorough due diligence on the rationale behind each investment.

articles.title: Hedge funds retreat from tech at fastest pace in a decade as AI trade weakens
articles.desc: Hedge funds cut technology exposure at the fastest pace in at least a decade as the global AI trade weakened and tech stocks bore the brunt of last week’s selloff. Goldman Sachs data showed funds reduced risk sharply, although technology remained a major part of their portfolios.

articles.title: Uneven rains may keep price of spices elevated
articles.desc: Southern India is currently grappling with challenges in spice production, primarily due to uneven monsoon patterns and parched soil, which are adversely affecting harvest yields. Despite expanding cultivation areas, turmeric yields are predicted to plummet owing to unfavorable weather. Additionally, delays in red chilli sowing in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana could lead to surging market prices.

articles.title: India-New Zealand FTA comes into effect today
articles.desc: The FTA will provide Indian exporters with 100% duty-free access to the New Zealand market, opening opportunities for MSMEs, women entrepreneurs, farmers and artisans. This is expected to facilitate $20 billion in investments into India in 15 years that would create opportunities across manufacturing, infrastructure, agriculture, and innovation.

articles.title: US banning Chinese AI DeepSeek from government agency IT systems
articles.desc: The department is also banning acquisition of DeepSeek products and third-party services developed using DeepSeek by US civilian government agencies. DHS said DeepSeek models pose "multiple threat vectors" and raised concerns that use of the product "may result in the transfer of sensitive data to the PRC if used by US government employees or vendors."

articles.title: Netflix film division boss to exit in second senior departure in a week
articles.desc: Netflix said on Monday its film division head Dan Lin would leave after nearly three years at the helm, marking a second senior executive departure in less than a week amid concerns

articles.title: Ex-OpenAI employee accused of planting device appears to have Saudi backing: court filing
articles.desc: US prosecutors allege that the defendant, Abdulrahman Alfozan, 35, was in frequent communication with an unnamed member of the Saudi Royal family and that a member of the Saudi military paid for a one-way plane ticket for Alfozan's wife and son to return to Saudi Arabia, according to the court document.

articles.title: US bans DeepSeek AI from government use as tech tension with China continues
articles.desc: DeepSeek is a powerful, popular and relatively inexpensive artificial intelligence model out of China.

articles.title: Apple to host 'Pro and tell' event on October 28 in LA
articles.desc: Apple said on Monday it would host a "Pro and tell" event in Los Angeles on October 28, the latest in a series of product launches as the iPhone maker expands its hardware lineup and AI offerings.

articles.title: S&P Global flags potentially hidden AI debt at hyperscalers as AI spending surges
articles.desc: S&P Global warned that hyperscalers could be carrying more AI related debt than currently visible through financing structures linked to data centres and smaller AI firms. Despite rising concerns around AI infrastructure debt, the agency saw no immediate need for rating changes, while flagging profitability and escalating investment as key risks.

articles.title: Tariff quota notified for New Zealand fruits, honey
articles.desc: Kiwifruit imports will qualify for zero customs duty under the tariff rate quota (TRQ), subject to a minimum CIF value of $1.80 per kg while 40 tonnes of New Zealand-certified Manuka honey under the quota have been permitted for 2026. The annual limit will increase to 200 tonnes from 2027.

articles.title: Jio IPO: LIC, BlackRock, Fidelity, GIC among 212 anchor investors to pour Rs 8,110 crore
articles.desc: Jio Platforms successfully raised approximately Rs 8,110 crore from 212 anchor investors before its upcoming IPO. The company allotted shares to well-known investors such as LIC, BlackRock, and Fidelity. These allocations indicate strong interest from both domestic and global institutional investors. The IPO is expected to surpass the previous record held by Hyundai Motor India. Jio Platforms aims to achieve an equity valuation of nearly Rs 10.3 lakh crore.

articles.title: Central Bank of India reports technical glitch in RTGS outward system
articles.desc: Central Bank said that no customer suffered any financial loss on account of the incident. The lender has not attributed the disruption to a cyberattack and said the root cause is still under examination.

articles.title: CBDT exempts interest payments on rupee-denominated bonds issued by New Development Bank from TDS
articles.desc: The exemption applies to holders of Maharajah INR Bonds who are Indian residents or foreign institutional investors, for the 2026-27 tax year and subsequent tax years.

articles.title: AI stocks rebound as CoreWeave jumps on Goldman Sachs upgrade
articles.desc: AI stocks rebound after last week’s sharp selloff, with semiconductor stocks leading the recovery. CoreWeave gains after Goldman Sachs upgrades the stock to buy, while Intel, Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom also rise. Investors now turn to upcoming technology earnings for clues on AI spending, valuations, debt and interest rates.

articles.title: Ireda net profit grows to Rs 554 cr in Sep qtr
articles.desc: Ireda has announced a net profit of Rs 554 crore for the September quarter of FY27, reflecting a robust financial performance. Revenue from operations increased by 14%, totaling Rs 2,345 crore. Additionally, loan disbursements surged by 31%, reaching Rs 10,579 crore. This quarter also marked an 11% rise in net worth, showcasing Ireda's strength in renewable energy financing and management of asset quality.

articles.title: Amazon says its AI chips will work with popular coding language, challenging Nvidia
articles.desc: Amazon has unveiled TorchNeuron, a revolutionary tool that enables PyTorch code to be executed seamlessly on its Trainium AI chips. This innovation claims to minimize the need for extensive code alterations, making integration easier for developers. Over 30 early adopters have attested to remarkable cost efficiencies, prompting industry giants like Nvidia and Google to amp up their own offerings.

articles.title: Amazon is funding a new nuclear plant in Indiana
articles.desc: Amazon has signed an agreement with X-energy and American Electric Power (AEP) to fund the building of a new nuclear energy facility in Indiana. The proposed plant, which would replace the now defunct coal-fueled Breed Generating Station in Fairbanks, Sullivan County, aims to provide up to 960 megawatts of carbon-free energy for both the regional […]

articles.title: Nvidia wins fast-growing AI startup Modal for new central processors
articles.desc: Modal, a cloud-computing startup that rents out computing power to AI developers, said it plans to start using Nvidia's new Vera central processor for the first time for hosting agents, the AI systems that can carry out long-running tasks for human users. Modal until now has run such work only on Intel and AMD chips.

articles.title: Global Markets: French markets tumble as riots add to political crisis
articles.desc: Protests across France have led to significant declines in the country's financial markets and stocks. French government officials requested local authorities to consider imposing curfews amid the unrest. The rise in bond yields suggests increasing investor concern over France's budgetary challenges and economic outlook. Major French banks have experienced stock declines, reflecting the heightened risk of insuring French debt.

articles.title: US Treasury yields nudge higher as AI fears ebb
articles.desc: US Treasury yields experienced a rise alongside a boost in equities, particularly driven by AI stocks, which has mitigated earlier anxieties among investors. The 10-year Treasury yield saw a modest rebound after a steep decline, indicating a shift in market mood. Moreover, oil prices declined, easing inflation fears related to global tensions.

articles.title: Bajaj Finance Q2 consolidated net profit rises 29% to Rs 6,367 crore
articles.desc: Bajaj Finance expects AUM to grow 26-27% in FY27 as it accelerates customer acquisition and loan disbursements. The lender plans to book 60-62 million new loans and add 18-20 million customers during the year. Consolidated AUM grew 26% to Rs 5.85 lakh crore in the September quarter, aided by broad-based loan growth. The gold-loan portfolio more than doubled to Rs 24,195 crore, although short-tenor schemes caused a transitional increase in Stage 2 assets. Management does not expect this movement to affect credit costs. Lower funding costs, improving asset quality and a strong liquidity buffer should support growth.

articles.title: Waaree Renewable Technologies Q2 Results: Net profit falls 29% to Rs 81 crore
articles.desc: Waaree Renewable Technologies experienced a notable 29 percent drop in net profit for the quarter ending September. Their consolidated profit stood at Rs 81.48 crore, a decrease from Rs 116.36 crore year-on-year. While expenses surged, revenues rose to Rs 1,057.84 crore. The company boasts an unexecuted order book over Rs 5,500 crore and a robust bidding pipeline, striving for long-term value through efficiencies and scaling.

articles.title: India-New Zealand FTA kicks in October 20, gives all Indian goods zero-duty access
articles.desc: India's free trade agreement with New Zealand will begin on October 20 and provide duty-free access for Indian goods. This agreement aims to boost bilateral trade significantly by 2030, increasing it from $2.4 billion to nearly ₹35,000 crore. New Zealand will grant 100% market access, while India will provide tariff concessions on 70% of its tariff lines. Customs clearance timelines will be expedited, enhancing trade efficiency and reducing costs.

articles.title: JB Pritzker thinks AI could help us live to 100 — or threaten us like nukes
articles.desc: Today, I’m talking with Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker, who has a lot of thoughts about AI, tech, and privacy. If you’ve been listening to the show, you know that one of my running theories is that those issues are driving a big and maybe kind of unexpected political realignment — and with the midterms coming […]

articles.title: Major European mobile carriers are teaming up for a ‘direct’ satellite program without Starlink
articles.desc: Deutsche Telekom, Orange, Telefónica, and Vodafone signed a letter of intent saying they're considering a joint bid for spectrum that would support European direct-to-device satellite competition for SpaceX's Starlink. The four telecom companies say they would handle the ground infrastructure while a separate, unannounced satellite partner provides the satellite constellation: The joint initiative by Deutsche […]

articles.title: India sets import quotas for New Zealand apples, kiwifruit under FTA
articles.desc: India will implement a quota system for importing apples, kiwifruit, Manuka honey, and albumins from New Zealand. The quotas will gradually increase over five years, allowing for proper regulation of imports. Apple imports will be capped initially, with no allowances in the first year. The duty rates will vary depending on the product and its CIF value, affecting import dynamics.

articles.title: India-New Zealand FTA to kick in October 20, opening market opportunities for exporters
articles.desc: The India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement will come into effect on October 20, enhancing trade for both nations. New Zealand expects increased demand for its agricultural products, particularly kiwifruit, honey, and apples, in India. The agreement includes provisions to ensure tariff-free access for Indian goods in New Zealand's market. Both countries aim to strengthen economic ties and improve productivity in agricultural sectors.

articles.title: India probing Pernod, Diageo Scotch imports under India-UK trade pact, sources say
articles.desc: Indian tax officials are investigating Pernod Ricard and Diageo for how they classified bulk Scotch imports. These companies may have improperly benefitted from reduced tariffs under a recent trade agreement. Tax inspectors made surprising visits to both companies' offices to gather information about their practices. The investigations are part of a broader scrutiny faced by foreign investors in India.

articles.title: Titan redeems Rs 1,000 crore commercial paper
articles.desc: Titan Company Ltd has successfully fulfilled its obligation by redeeming commercial papers worth Rs 1,000 crore, originally issued on July 21, 2026. As the maturity date has arrived, all investors have duly received their returns. This action adheres to the regulations established by the Securities and Exchange Board of India. As part of the Tata Group and functioning under the Tamil Nadu government, Titan encompasses various lifestyle brands.

articles.title: Yes Bank CET1 may fall to 10% if past AT1 coupons are paid: Crisil
articles.desc: Yes Bank faces a potential decline in core equity capital, projected to fall to around 10% due to accumulated coupon payments on AT1 bonds. Crisil Ratings highlighted a significant liability impact estimated at Rs 6,200 crore, while S&P Global Ratings foresees a reduction in common equity by about Rs 8,400 crore. Despite these concerns, both agencies believe the bank's credit profile will remain stable.

articles.title: Piramal Finance Q2 net profit soars 67% to Rs 545 crore
articles.desc: Piramal Finance’s assets under management grew 24% to Rs 1.13 lakh crore, led by a 30% rise in retail AUM. Net interest income increased 35%, while its net interest margin expanded 35 basis points to 6.5%.

articles.title: PC Jeweller among 8 stocks that hit 52-week high and rallied up to 42% in a month
articles.desc: The Sensex plunged 876 points to close at 73,852, even as eight BSE 1000 stocks touched fresh 52-week highs. PC Jeweller led monthly gains at 42%, followed by Sky Gold and Diamonds at 31%, highlighting divergent stock performance.

articles.title: US stocks today: S&P 500, Nasdaq climb as AI-linked stocks recover ahead of earnings
articles.desc: US stocks saw a significant recovery as semiconductor shares attracted investor attention following steep declines. The Nasdaq 100 and S&P 500 both experienced gains in early trading, offering relief to tech investors. Notable tech companies like CoreWeave saw increases after concerns about their business sustainability were addressed. Additionally, SpaceX and Tesla gained value amid speculation over potential corporate actions.

articles.title: Zetwerk IPO fully subscribed; Super.money triples revenues
articles.desc: Zetwerk’s Rs 5,012-crore IPO was subscribed 3.06 times on Monday, the last day for bids. This and more in today’s ETtech Top 5.

articles.title: China announces export curbs on key machinery used in India's infrastructure development
articles.desc: Beijing has announced new export controls on essential machinery, which will impact India's infrastructure development. These restrictions will take effect on November 18 and apply to tunnel boring machines and related items. Additionally, the export controls include walking excavators and specific dredger-related items, complicating several Indian projects.

articles.title: Lab-grown diamond startup So/Facet raises Rs 10 crore led by Sauce
articles.desc: The round also saw participation from Mokobara cofounders Sangeet Agrawal and Navin Parwal, Chona Family Office (that’s behind Hocco Ice Creams), Haleon South Asia president Kedar Lele, and Moonshot co-founder Devaiah Bopanna.

articles.title: India bonds give up day's gains as oil price spike adds to rate hike fears
articles.desc: Indian government bonds ended lower as inflation concerns increased due to rising crude oil prices. The benchmark 10-year bond yield has been rising for nine consecutive weeks, causing worries about further rate hikes. Economists predict consumer inflation might exceed the upper tolerance band of the Reserve Bank of India. Additionally, the Reserve Bank has taken measures to curb currency speculation and stabilize the financial market.

articles.title: Auto tech companies raise $1.3 billion in 2026 so far: Tracxn
articles.desc: The funding rounds were led by ride-hailing firm Rapido's $240 million, followed by electric two-wheeler manufacturer Simple Energy's $180 million and River's $102 million.

articles.title: Netflix faces questions on user engagement ahead of third-quarter report
articles.desc: Ted Sarandos, the co-CEO of Netflix, recently admitted the company "is not growing as fast as I want us to", and suggested live programming could be an opportunity to accelerate growth.

articles.title: Bereaved families could face 'unjust' tax bill after civil service pension delays
articles.desc: The chairman of Parliament's Public Accounts Committee says families should not be taxed through no fault of their own.

articles.title: Bajaj Finance Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 29% YoY to Rs 6,367 crore, NII up 24%
articles.desc: Bajaj Finance Q2 Results: Bajaj Finance reported a 29% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 6,367 crore in the September quarter, compared with Rs 4,948 crore a year earlier. Net interest income rose 24% to Rs 13,335 crore from Rs 10,785 crore in the year-ago quarter. Net total income increased 23% to Rs 15,974 crore from Rs 12,982 crore.

articles.title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today | Highlights: Nasdaq leads Wall Street gains as chip, AI stocks rebound
Elon Musk pledges a share of SpaceX company to 'every kid in America'
articles.desc: In a groundbreaking move, Elon Musk revealed his intention to distribute one share of SpaceX to every child in America. This announcement comes on the heels of Anthropic's commitment to allocate 5 percent of its shares to a public benefit fund aimed at harmonizing financial success with social impacts. With SpaceX recently hitting the stock market, Musk has also claimed the title of the world's first trillionaire.

articles.title: NABVENTURES plans Rs 30-70 crore bets on growth-stage firms in Fund II
articles.desc: NABVENTURES aims to invest ₹30-70 crore per company in agriculture, rural financial services, and climate solutions. The venture capital arm plans to focus on technology-driven businesses and growth-stage companies with established traction. Larger initial checks will be adapted for follow-on funding in high-performing portfolio companies. The emphasis will be on sustainable scaling in large markets, improving productivity, and raising farmers' incomes.

articles.title: Trump waives Russia sanctions, easing India’s energy concerns as US trade deal nears
articles.desc: US President Donald Trump waived key Russian sanctions which may enhance trade relations with India. This decision is expected to provide negotiating space for a potential trade deal. India, one of the largest importers of Russian oil, faces challenges due to declining imports. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is visiting India to discuss cooperation on this matter. The waiver could help India secure more favorable tariffs while stabilizing energy policies.

articles.title: Copper falls as LME stocks edge higher and mine supply concerns ease
articles.desc: Copper prices have dipped due to rising inventories culminating from a resolution of a major strike at a Chilean mine. With available copper stocks hitting a two-month peak following substantial inflows, expert analyst Daniel Ghali pointed to US tariffs impacting global supply chains and shipping costs. In contrast, China exhibits signs of economic growth, notwithstanding ongoing struggles in its property sector.

articles.title: Jio IPO draws Rs 2.5 lakh crore in anchor bids from over 70 investors
articles.desc: Jio Platforms’ Rs 30,188 cr IPO has attracted institutional bids worth around Rs 2.5 lakh cr, more than 30 times the size of its anchor book. Over 70 investors, including global asset managers, sovereign wealth funds, domestic mutual funds and insurers, have expressed interest ahead of the October 21 opening.

articles.title: Hindustan Zinc Q2 Results: Net profit skyrockets 142% YoY to Rs 6,412 crore, revenue soars 77%
articles.desc: Hindustan Zinc reported a 142% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 6,412 crore, while revenue surged 76.5% to Rs 15,093 crore. EBITDA doubled to Rs 9,285 crore, with margins expanding to 62% on higher prices and production.

articles.title: Textiles Ministry identifies 4,000 startups for export growth support
articles.desc: The textiles ministry has identified over 4,000 textile-based startups for support to scale up and become export-ready over the next three to four years. Consultations with registered startups and small businesses are expected to begin in late November or early December, followed by a national startup conclave in December to assess their needs.

articles.title: ISB programme explores AI’s growing role in the future of digital finance
articles.desc: The Executive Programme in Fintech and AI at ISB is crafted to equip finance professionals with cutting-edge skills in financial services. Spanning 32 weeks, this program offers live online sessions alongside engaging experiential learning. Participants will delve into real-world applications of fintech, artificial intelligence, and blockchain. Tailored for senior finance leaders, this course seeks to enhance strategic decision-making. Applications for the next cohort are now open, creating valuable networking opportunities.

articles.title: RDI fund to spur 10-fold investment from private sector, says NITI's Abhay Karandikar
articles.desc: The Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) scheme aims to significantly increase private sector investment in India. It is designed to catalyse nearly Rs 10-lakh crore in investment over the next ten years while creating new job opportunities. The focus will be on crucial technology areas like artificial intelligence, biotechnology, and space technologies.

US very close to finalising trade deal with India, says Marco Rubio
articles.desc: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Monday that Washington is close to finalising a trade deal with India. He said the US considers various factors, including ongoing trade negotiations, while making decisions on national security waivers related to Russian oil and gas sanctions.
